title: Breaking Free from Poverty through Faithful Giving
description: Join Pastor Chris Zehner as he delves into the powerful topic of giving and how it can bring about a breakthrough in your life. He reveals how giving purges your heart from self-centered thinking and postures you to receive from God, and shares personal testimonies of how God has worked in the lives of those who have applied these principles. Don't miss this inspiring message that will challenge you to step into the kingdom of God and receive the harvest you've been waiting for.
